defs.def: not under the control or in the power of sb else; able to do what you want 能随自己意愿的；随心所欲的

ex.s: Talking freely with your doctor can make you feel better and gives your doctor the information she or he needs to give you the best care.
ex.src: 2020全国新高考II卷·Talking with your doctor
ex.t: 与你的医生畅所欲言能让你感觉更好，也能让你的医生得到他/她所需的信息，从而给你最好的治疗。

ex.s: Please feel free to stop me if you have any questions.
ex.t: 如果有任何问题，请随时打断我。

ex.s: It also has a voice control setting that enables you to stay hands-free, while its waterproof band is fully adjustable so that it is comfortable to wear.
ex.t: 它还带有语音控制设置，让你无需动手，而其防水的表带可完全调节，佩戴舒适。

ex.s: So even if your own efforts at humor fall short, you might be freeing the long kept humor in others.
ex.t: 所以即使你自己的幽默努力不够完美，你也可能释放了他人心中长期压抑的幽默。

ex.s: Fruit juices, milk-based drinks and most alcoholic drinks are free of the tax, as are small companies manufacturing fewer than 1m litres per year.
ex.t: 帮助下一代拥有健康活跃的童年非常重要，行业也在尽自己的一份力。

defs.def: not restricted or controlled by anyone else; able to do or say what you want 不受限制的；不受约束的；言行自由的

ex.s: When I was a little girl, I liked drawing, freely and joyously making marks on the walls at home.
ex.t: 当我还是个小女孩时，我喜欢画画，自由而快乐地在家里墙上涂画。

ex.s: Stay loose and free.
ex.t: 保持放松和自由。

ex.s: One Monday morning, while the children were enjoying “free play”, I stepped to the doorway of the classroom to take a break.
ex.t: 一个周一早晨，当孩子们正享受自由玩耍时，我走到教室门口休息一下。

ex.s: Feeling free to change topics.
ex.t: 自由地转换话题。

ex.s: Now I'm free.
ex.t: 现在我自由了。

ex.s: As they grew more mobile, we let them move freely around the house during the day, but when we were asleep we had to contain them in a large room, otherwise they'd get up to mischief.
ex.t: 随着它们越来越能活动，白天我们让它们在屋里自由走动，但我们睡着时得把它们关在一个大房间里，否则它们会调皮捣蛋。

defs.def: not a prisoner or slave 人

ex.s: When people see you trying to be funny, it frees them to try it themselves.
ex.t: 当人们看到你在努力变得有趣时，这让他们也敢于尝试。

ex.s: When some refuse vaccination and seek a free ride, immunity breaks down and everyone is in even bigger danger.
ex.t: 当一些人拒绝接种疫苗想搭便车，免疫力就会崩溃，每个人都面临更大的危险。

ex.s: Many supermarkets are no longer doing “buy one get one free” promotions because of the   60   (criticize) that they lead to waste.
ex.t: 许多超市不再做'买一送一'促销活动，因为有人____60____（批评）这会导致浪费。

defs.def: not tied up or in a cage 未拴住的；非关在笼中的
costing nothing 不收费的
clear; not blocked 无阻碍的；畅通的
not containing or affected by sth harmful or unpleasant 不含有害物的；不受 … 伤害（或影响等的）

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.s: It is free of sweeteners.
ex.t: 它不含甜味剂。

ex.s: This means we don’t eat meat, and any milk or cheese had better be dairy-free.
ex.t: 这意味着我们不吃肉，任何牛奶或奶酪最好不含乳制品。

ex.s: This means we don't eat meat, and any milk or cheese had better be dairy-free.
ex.t: 这意味着我们不吃肉，任何牛奶或奶酪最好不含乳制品。

defs.def: without the thing mentioned 构成形容词
not attached to sth or trapped by sth 未固定的；未缚住的
not being used 未使用的；空着的

ex.s: The museum was free． We entered， excited． A group of people sitting in the hall stopped talking and stared at us．
ex.t: 博物馆免费。我们兴奋地走进去。大厅里坐着的一群人停下交谈，盯着我们看。

defs.def: without particular plans or arrangements; not busy 人或时间

ex.s: In your free time, you can explore the city, have language classes, surf or choose your favourite from among the following.
ex.t: 在空闲时间，你可以探索城市、上语言课、冲浪，或从以下选项中挑选你最喜欢的。

ex.s: 00 amWork at the project sites, or enjoy your free time
ex.t: 10:00 am 在项目点工作，或享受自由时间

ex.s: For example, in our free time we can sculpt a sculpture and paint a painting, but we take a photo.
ex.t: 例如，在空闲时间，我们可以雕刻一件雕塑、画一幅画，但我们拍一张照片。

defs.def: ready to give sth, especially when it is not wanted 随便给出的
a free translation is not exact but gives the general meaning 不拘泥原文的；（翻译）根据大意的；意译的

ex.s: It all feels free and easy.
ex.t: 一切感觉轻松自在。

ex.s: High places are free of air pollution.
ex.t: 高处没有空气污染。

ex.s: The hospital school is free of parents, doctors, and medical procedures.
ex.t: 这对我来说是一个恍然大悟的时刻，从此我再也不会以同样的方式看待结局了。

defs.def: to allow sb to leave prison or somewhere they have been kept against their will 释放；使自由

ex.s: They looked and sounded so free.
ex.t: 他们看起来和听起来都那么自由自在。

ex.s: It would allow much room for free thinking．
ex.t: B．它将为自由思考提供很大空间

defs.def: to move sb/sth that is caught or fixed on sth 释放；使摆脱

ex.s: In that sense, I’m pretty sure volunteering is more of a selfish act than I’d freely like to admit.
ex.t: 从这个意义上说，我很确定志愿服务比我愿意承认的更像是一种自私的行为。

ex.s: It frees them from aches.
ex.t: 它让他们摆脱酸痛。

ex.s: After a struggle, she managed to free the vehicle and continued inching along the snow-covered road.
ex.t: 一番挣扎后，她设法把车弄了出来，继续在积雪覆盖的道路上缓慢前行。

defs.def: to remove sth that is unpleasant or not wanted from sb/sth 解除（或去除、清除）
to make sb/sth available for a particular purpose 使可用（于某目的）
to give sb the extra time to do sth that they want to do 使能腾出时间

ex.s: You would think learning takes more time from you, but actually there are always new ways of doing things that can save you time on daily tasks, freeing you up for the most important.
ex.t: 你或许以为学习占用了你更多时间，但其实总有新的做事方式能让你在日常任务上节省时间，从而腾出精力处理最重要的事。

ex.s: Young Children Need More Free Time
ex.t: 戴维·邦德：儿童的榜样

defs.def: without payment 免费

ex.s: And these books were free.
ex.t: 这些书都是免费的。

ex.s: There are plenty of other benefits, too; it doesn’t charge city tax; it has both air conditioning and a heater for the rooms; it also has free Wi-Fi in every room.
ex.t: 还有很多其他好处：不收城市税；房间里有空调和暖气；每个房间还有免费Wi-Fi。

ex.s: Far from charging consumers high prices, many of these services are free (users pay, in effect, by handing over yet more data).
ex.t: 远非向消费者收取高价，许多这类服务都是免费的（用户实际上是通过交出更多数据来付费的）。

ex.s: Tina Stern   17   rides from Wilson for all her four years in college, and the trips meant much more to her than just free   18  .
ex.t: 蒂娜·斯特恩在大学四年____17____搭威尔逊的车，这些行程对她而言远不止免费的____18____。

ex.s: Admission to lectures is free.
ex.t: 听讲座免费入场。

ex.s: During my second year at the city college, I was told that the education department was offering a “free” course, called Thinking Chess, for three credits.
ex.t: 我在城市学院读大二时，听说教育系开设了一门名为"国际象棋思维"的"免费"课程，可获得3个学分。

ex.s: Enjoy fun history as we take you through San Francisco for a free taste of ice cream.
ex.t: 在旧金山免费品尝冰淇淋的同时，享受有趣的历史之旅吧。

ex.s: A Toronto man is offering a free round-the-world air to the right woman.
ex.t: 一名多伦多男子向合适的女性提供免费环游世界的机票。

ex.s: He 23   to fix bikes free of charge for anyone who needed it.
ex.t: 他   23   承诺免费为任何需要的人修理自行车。

ex.s: It provides phone service for free.
ex.t: 报名并不意味着你就能自动注册并参与本项目。

ex.s: He found there were excellent free books.
ex.t: 他发现那里有很棒的免费书。

ex.s: It organizes free cycle tours.
ex.t: 它组织免费骑行游览。

ex.s: The free accommodations.
ex.t: 免费住宿。

ex.s: What is the deadline for a free enrollment list change?
ex.t: 免费更改注册名单的截止日期是什么时候？

ex.s: Children under 12 years accompanied by an adult are admitted free.
ex.t: 12岁以下由成人陪同的儿童免费入场。

ex.s: What childhood experience gave Sullivan the idea to make free toys for kids? (no more than 15 words)
ex.t: 是什么童年经历让沙利文产生了为孩子们制作免费玩具的想法？（不超过15个单词）

ex.s: Staff members hold plenty of bar events for guests like free shots, bar crawls and karaoke.
ex.t: 工作人员为客人举办很多酒吧活动，如免费酒水、酒吧巡游和卡拉OK。

ex.s: We will be holding a free taster session on 23rd May, at 10 am, to demonstrate the variety of effective and active exercises.
ex.t: 我们将于5月23日上午10点举办一场免费体验课，展示各种有效且活跃的锻炼方式。

ex.s: How many people can each grand prize winner take on the free trip? （    ）
ex.t: 每位大奖获得者可以带多少人参加免费旅行？（    ）

ex.s: Your replacement card will be produced free of charge.
ex.t: 你的换卡将免费制作。

ex.s: Your card will be produced free of charge.
ex.t: 你的卡将免费制作。

ex.s: A retired engineer, 76-year-old Wilson has been   11   free rides to college students for the past eight years.
ex.t: 76岁的退休工程师威尔逊，过去八年一直在给大学生___11___免费搭载。

ex.s: And, even if I weren’t  43  enough about free credits, news about our  44   was appealing enough to me.
ex.t: 而且，即使我对免费学分不够____43____，关于我们____44____的消息也足够吸引我了。

ex.s: Have free ice cream.
ex.t: 免费吃冰淇淋。

ex.s: They no longer provide free services.
ex.t: 它们不再提供免费服务。
